info.title: Stray Map External Intake — CONTRACT DRAFT
info.description: Disabled draft v3 with unchanged v2 acceptance/hash compatibility. No official intake API verified, complete production rebuild source or approved terms exception. V3 distinguishes LOST/FOUND/SIGHTING, health and custody. Source events and bounded manual matching are private synthetic supervisor interfaces, not HTTP/public APIs. No production writes, credentials or patrol/schedule changes.

servers.description: Non-routable documentation placeholder; never a production endpoint.

x-activation-prerequisites: Proven production source and release path
Approved source registry and abuse controls
Verified private uploader and rights workflow
Atomic idempotency store and moderation visibility/role acceptance

post.summary: DISABLED PROPOSAL: private external tip intake, v3 and compatible v2
post.description: No implemented official route. V2 remains accepted without payload/hash/fingerprint changes; v3 adds exact report semantics and health-only condition enum. Every tip enters private PENDING review. Only approved safe source-visible v3 SIGHTING is eligible as a map marker; LOST/FOUND/legacy are lead records, never inferred new sightings. Private source events and matching add no HTTP path.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Publisher-scoped random retry key; not authentication. Identical canonical payload replays original receipt; conflict is 409. Future store must implement atomicity/retention.

parameters.name: Content-Encoding
parameters.description: Absent/identity only. Reject compressed input before parsing.

requestBody.description: 16,384-byte JSON UTF-8 cap; strict TipV2 or TipV3. Shared source/time/region/language/privacy/photo rules remain. Runtime enforces IANA/chronology/custody policy. No client publication/device controls, remote image fetch or production mutation.

202.description: PROPOSED ONLY: durable private PENDING receipt, or exact original receipt replay. Validation alone does not produce this HTTP acceptance.

400.description: Invalid exact v2 structure, temporal/zone/chronology, locale/text, coarse country/region, JSON, photo metadata or idempotency input. No production mutation.

403.description: Publisher/dataset not matched to trusted verified server policy. Body claims and optional URL are not authorization.

409.description: Same publisher-scoped idempotency key with changed canonical payload, or conflicting content for a separately unique publisher/dataset/recordKey. Never overwrite or automatically merge independent cases.

415.description: JSON UTF-8 and identity encoding only.

429.description: Future adapter quota; no limiter is implemented here.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until retry; future adapter only.

500.description: Fail closed on invalid internal context/state or unexpected failure.

503.description: Disabled by default or a required dependency/prerequisite is unavailable.

Tip.description: Accept unchanged v2 or v3. V2 has its original nine exact keys, legacy condition enum and unchanged canonical payload/hash/fingerprint; v3 adds only the required report object and separates health from report semantics.

datasetId.description: Reviewed dataset slug, 3–64 lower-case letters/digits/hyphens starting with a letter; must match trusted sourcePolicy.

recordKey.description: Private opaque stable identifier within publisherId/datasetId. Separately unique source-record identity; never a public case ID, URL or automatic merge instruction.

url.description: Optional private evidence: HTTPS canonical URL or null. When present, enforce existing safe syntactic URL/origin/path rules, discard only approved tracking/fragment data, and never fetch. A null URL does not bypass verified publisher/dataset/provenance checks and is not a unique key.

countryCode.description: Upper-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code; schema checks shape, not a full country registry. Known region must share this prefix and be permitted by trusted sourcePolicy. Even if regionCode is null, at least one allowedRegions entry must have this country prefix.

regionCode.description: ISO 3166-2 shaped coarse region code. Must match countryCode and the trusted server allowedRegions list. This pattern is not a complete global subdivision registry. Null means unknown.

caption.description: Original-language caption in the tip display locale; private/untrusted before review. No personal or sensitive location data. A caption never proves image rights or same-case accuracy. Trimmed, no C0/DEL controls; length is 1–240 Unicode code points in both executable contract and JSON Schema.
caption.x-runtime-length-unit: Unicode code points; matches JSON Schema maxLength.

evidenceRef.description: Opaque private per-image permission/license and edits/consent evidence, verified by uploader; never a public URL.

attributionRef.description: Opaque reviewed non-identifying credit/license/modification record. Omit photo if attribution/privacy cannot both be satisfied.

error.description: Bounded machine-readable code. Existing response x-error-codes are illustrative, not an exhaustive v2 code registry; semantic validator/rehearsal errors must not echo submitted values.

NullableCount.description: Illustrative aggregate component only, no statistics endpoint. Zero requires an available verified source. Unknown, missing, invalid or unavailable = null. Replays/candidate hashes are not new tips/confirmed deduplicated cases.

Temporal.description: Exactly precision/value/timeZone. Disjoint tagged variants; runtime verifies real dates, recognized IANA zones, INSTANT offset-zone agreement (including DST), and precision-aware chronology against server submittedAt. Preserve uncertainty; DATE is not UTC midnight. UNKNOWN requires two nulls. JSON Schema does not perform zone lookup or chronology checks.

value.description: Implemented RFC3339 subset: seconds with optional exactly three fractional digits, uppercase T/Z or numeric offset. Runtime checks that IANA-zone local wallclock at the parsed instant equals the supplied wallclock; invalid dates, zone/offset mismatches and DST gaps are rejected. Other fractional widths/leap-second forms are not supported.

timeZone.description: Valid IANA zone recognized by runtime Intl, maximum 80 UTF-16 code units. Examples: Asia/Taipei, America/Los_Angeles, UTC. Runtime lookup required; no complete zone registry is embedded here.

value.description: Real local calendar date. Retain the original date plus IANA zone; never synthesize a clock time or convert it to UTC midnight.

timeZone.description: Valid IANA zone recognized by runtime Intl, maximum 80 UTF-16 code units. Examples: Asia/Taipei, America/Los_Angeles, UTC. Runtime lookup required; no complete zone registry is embedded here.

locale.description: Current supported canonical BCP47 subset: lower-case 2/3-letter language, optional Titlecase four-letter script, optional upper-case two-letter region. Must equal Intl.getCanonicalLocales output. Examples zh-TW, en-US, zh-Hant-TW. Variants, extensions, private-use and numeric-region tags are outside this implementation; no forced translation.

title.description: Original-language title, private/untrusted until review. Length is not privacy, copyright or HTML-safety approval. Must be trimmed, single-line and free of C0/DEL controls. Runtime and JSON Schema both count Unicode code points without altering original text.
title.x-runtime-length-unit: Unicode code points; matches JSON Schema maxLength.

description.description: Original-language clue description, private/untrusted until review. No automatic pass-through to map, Hub, logs or public output. Must be trimmed, single-line and free of C0/DEL controls. Runtime and JSON Schema both count Unicode code points without altering original text.
description.x-runtime-length-unit: Unicode code points; matches JSON Schema maxLength.

origin.description: Trusted exact canonical HTTPS origin, no userinfo/path/query/fragment or non-default port; checked at runtime. Required even for a source record with null URL.

pathPrefix.description: Trusted reviewed post-path prefix, used only when source URL is present.

items.description: ISO 3166-2 shaped coarse region code. Must match countryCode and the trusted server allowedRegions list. This pattern is not a complete global subdivision registry.

allowedRegions.description: Explicit reviewed source/dataset allowlist, e.g. TW-TPE and US-WA. Not a complete global region table.

SourcePolicy.description: SERVER-OWNED CONTEXT ONLY, never an accepted Tip field or public authorization claim. No new credential is created. Publisher/dataset must match; source-record stable identity is publisherId+datasetId+recordKey, independent of URL.

photos.description: Ordered unique uploadId references only; empty is valid. Each caption stays in the display locale/original language and private before review. No image URL, bytes or base64. Real safety/rights checks require the verified uploader.

condition.description: Health only; independent of animal kind and report type. ROAMING remains v2-only and is not translated into a health state.

asOf.description: Known Temporal; not definitely after publication/server now and not definitely before the FOUND observation. Precision-aware comparisons are runtime rules; no custody location is inferred.

ReportV3.description: Disjoint report semantics. LOST→LAST_KNOWN, FOUND→FOUND_AT, SIGHTING→OBSERVED_AT. Only FOUND permits known custody status/time; runtime enforces chronology.

LegacyReportProjection.description: Derived v2 public/private projection only. Never added to the accepted v2 payload/hash, never guessed from old condition/text, never treated as a new sighting.

photos.description: Ordered unique uploadId references only; empty is valid. Each caption stays in the display locale/original language and private before review. No image URL, bytes or base64. Real safety/rights checks require the verified uploader.

PublicCaseSemantics.description: Semantics included in the synthetic public-list item, not the complete item schema. Visibility additionally requires APPROVED + publicVisible + safe mapPolicy + PRESENT and not CLOSED_BY_SOURCE. Eligibility is not approval. No care location is inferred.

datasetId.description: Reviewed dataset slug, 3–64 lower-case letters/digits/hyphens starting with a letter; must match trusted sourcePolicy.

recordKey.description: Private opaque stable identifier within publisherId/datasetId. Separately unique source-record identity; never a public case ID, URL or automatic merge instruction.

SourceEvent.description: Private synthetic supervisor/fixture interface only; no HTTP endpoint. Publisher/dataset must match trusted policy and target an existing source record. Source time may be UNKNOWN and must not be guessed/future. ABSENT requires out-of-band trusted completeSnapshot=true when applying a new ABSENT event. Event identity is publisherId+datasetId+eventKey; same payload replays the durable original event receipt, changed payload conflicts.

SourceEventReceipt.description: Server-generated immutable private event acknowledgement. receivedAt is server receipt time, never substituted for sourceChangedAt; the original tip receipt is unchanged.

sourceChangedAt.description: Latest KNOWN source update, not the closure timestamp. An UNKNOWN closure event may leave an older known value here; use closureEvidence for closure precision.

closureEvidence.description: Optional private evidence captured on the first EXPLICIT_CLOSED event when absent. Preserve that event's exact original Temporal, including UNKNOWN; never inherit sourceState.sourceChangedAt or substitute server receivedAt as closure time. receivedAt is the separate server receipt timestamp. Later events do not overwrite this first evidence; no reunion is inferred. Older snapshots without this field remain valid and are not backfilled with guessed values.

SourceState.description: Private state, lazily defaulted for old version-1 snapshots. NOT_CONFIRMED_CLOSED does not assert OPEN. sourceChangedAt is the latest KNOWN source update, never a derived closure timestamp. Optional closureEvidence preserves the first captured explicit closure event's original time precision independently, including UNKNOWN, with separate server receivedAt. EXPLICIT_CLOSED is source closure only, not reunion; counterpart receipts remain independent.

MatchingSuggestions.description: Bounded private supervisor result; no public HTTP route. Only v3 LOST/FOUND with same kind/country/region, safe mapPolicy, visible source and PENDING/APPROVED review status; reject definitely contradictory observation ordering. Limits are explicit; truncated means incomplete. No automated match, merge, duplicate decision, identity confidence or reunion.

requirements: Verified existing operator workflow; no new credentials
Separately supplied bounded bytes, never arbitrary remote fetch
Publisher + dataset + recordKey + same-case binding, plus canonical source URL when present
All pending photos/evidence private; no public pins for wildlife/sensitivity

x-source-identity.storeGuarantees: Separate source-record uniqueness and atomic retry receipts must be implemented/tested by the rehearsal and eventually proven production store; this OpenAPI creates neither.

x-rehearsal.scope: Synthetic publishers and example.invalid identities only; HTTP origins must be registered by this rehearsal module, never existing local tunnels or production hosts.
x-rehearsal.scheduleDriver: fake clock; no wall-clock standing schedule
storageDesign: exclusive single-writer lock; stale lock fails closed
x-rehearsal.publicList: No global publication block, then publiclyVisible(row): APPROVED historical review permission, safe mapPolicy and source-visible state. Private effectivePublicVisible combines the same guards; immutable receipt.publicVisible remains false. Includes report/mapMarkerEligible/careLocationInferred=false; only v3 SIGHTING eligible. No private source keys or real media URLs.
x-rehearsal.acceptance: Local synthetic contract, loopback HTTP, filesystem receipt/review and two-process milestones only. Image safety/rights are mocked metadata; no official API acceptance, production authority or exhaustive crash/multi-worker guarantee.

cli.destination: New unused absolute directory, existing parent; refuse existing destination, preserve partial evidence on failure.
cli.phaseIsolation: Separate first and restart child processes, bounded timeout; restart asserts different PID and receipt persistence.
cli.summary: RESULT.private.json; simulation=true, officialApiVerified=false, productionWrites=0, no deployment/patrol change.

first.repeatFakeTick: skip with no additional fixture-source request

restart.outage: Legacy noScope outage creates no new tip/immutable tip receipt; poll slot persists. Scoped mode additionally persists source-availability/event bookkeeping.

imageValidation.publicPhotoProjection: caption + simulatedMedia=true, no real media URL

transport.retryTrigger: Fetch failure, interrupted receipt stream or unusable successful JSON acknowledgement; one same-body/key POST retry only.
noRetryFor: Source GET within the same poll slot

sourceEvents.completeSnapshot: Trusted out-of-band context required for a new ABSENT transition. A committed identical event replays its receipt without reapplying the transition.
sourceEvents.explicitClosed: Only EXPLICIT_CLOSED sets CLOSED_BY_SOURCE. Reunion remains UNVERIFIED; independent counterpart receipts unchanged.
sourceEvents.presence: PRESENT restores availability only; cannot reopen CLOSED_BY_SOURCE or rejected/withdrawn review state.
sourceEvents.absenceOrFailure: ABSENT/UNAVAILABLE suppress public visibility; do not infer closure or reunion.
sourceEvents.sourceTime: Real original precision or UNKNOWN; reject definitely stale/future known times. Unknown never becomes server receipt time.
sourceEvents.snapshotCompatibility: Version remains 1; sourceEvents initialized lazily; sourceState defaults NOT_CONFIRMED_CLOSED/PRESENT with UNVERIFIED reunion. V2 payload/hash/fingerprint and original tip receipt unchanged.

scopedPolling.configuration: Optional server caller sourceScope={publisherId,datasetId}; must match verified policy.
scopedPolling.scopeMismatchOrGETFailure: Reject feed and mark existing scoped rows UNAVAILABLE; no closure or new tips.
scopedPolling.completeSnapshot: Only true trusted complete fixture snapshots derive ABSENT for unseen stored keys. Partial feeds do not infer absence.
scopedPolling.seenRefusal: Seen keys with refused POST become UNAVAILABLE, not ABSENT.
scopedPolling.successfulSeenKey: PRESENT availability; never reopen closed/rejected cases.
scopedPolling.noScopeCompatibility: No inferred source availability/status; explicitly supplied validated fixture events may still be processed.
scopedPolling.writesDuringOutage: Poll/source-availability/event bookkeeping only, no new tips or immutable tip receipts.
scopedPolling.transportExhaustionBoundary: Inspected loop exits on thrown second POST before final availability update; all-attempts-threw handling requires its dedicated regression.

caseCli.closure: Only LOST becomes CLOSED_BY_SOURCE; counterparts independent.
caseCli.completeSnapshotMissingRecord: Independent FOUND becomes ABSENT, never source-closed.
caseCli.presenceRecovery: Restore already-approved FOUND visibility only; preserve observation/custody times and CLOSED_BY_SOURCE state.
caseCli.summary: RESULT.private.json after all phases; simulation, no production writes/terms/patrol change, reunionConfirmed=false, officialApiVerified=false.
caseCli.media: No real photo bytes or real rights acceptance; fixtures use mocked metadata. Separate byte-worker verification is not folded into an assumed test total.

visibility.receiptPublicVisible: Immutable original PENDING receipt field remains false forever, including replays.
visibility.reviewPublicVisible: Historical/stored review permission only; may remain true after source status or global publication block hides the record.
visibility.effectivePublicVisible: Computed for private receipt lookup and successful review results: no global block AND publiclyVisible(row).
visibility.publicList: First enforces store-level publication block, then filters with publiclyVisible(row); list membership is current publication, not an old review permission.
visibility.mapMarkerEligible: Report semantics only, never overrides review/source/global visibility gates.
visibility.matchingSuggestions: Private only; no new public route.

effectivePublicVisible.description: Current combined visibility, false whenever publicationBlockedReason is non-null.

privateReviewResult.visibilityMeaning: Same combined visibility and block reason as private lookup; stored review permission is not current publication.

publicationCapacity.unknownVsZero: A blocked projection is unavailable, not a successful zero-count dataset.

x-legacy-v2-compatibility.expectedValues: Original payloadHash and candidateFingerprint obtained from the pinned pure-contract revision; never regenerate expectations from current code.
